headline: Goldman Sachs Cuts Kospi Target by 25% Amid Selloff in AI Stocks
summary: Goldman Sachs lowered its target for South Korea's benchmark Kospi index by 25% following a broad selloff in artificial intelligence equities.
why: The Kospi index is heavily weighted toward semiconductor and hardware technology exporters sensitive to global tech valuation trends.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: A 25% target reduction by Goldman Sachs reflects lowered equity valuation expectations across South Korean shares.

why_moved: A major Wall Street bank downgraded its benchmark forecast by a quarter due to ongoing price corrections across AI-linked equities.
